name: 90026 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90026 (Los Angeles) has 244 nonprofit organizations. 97 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 80 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90026 (Los Angeles) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90026 (Los Angeles) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 80 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.
